title: intel.experiment.exposed v1 payload
description: An account was assigned to a variant of a running experiment and served it for the first time (Tara Intelligence WP 5.5). Emitted once per (experiment, account) by a service that serves an experiment surface outside feed (graph, profile, marketplace). Ids and names only. Consumer: feed (intel_experiment_exposure, idempotent on (experiment_key, account_id)).
